journal_lines: §lCreeper§l in the brush. Wind at my back — smelled nothing until too late. Got clear anyway.
Backed up before the hiss finished. Gunpowder smell after.
Felled it at range. No point getting closer than you have to.
§cToo close when it started. §oEars still ringing.§o Fur singed at the shoulder.
Quiet until it isn't. Dealt with the quiet part first.
Circled it twice before it noticed me. Cleared it on the third pass.
Green thing standing perfectly still in the green. Saw the shape before I saw the color.
§oSmelled the sulfur before I saw it.§o Turned around. It had already found me.
No sound until the fuse. Then I was somewhere else.
Put it down before it could say anything about it.
§cBark off a nearby tree. §oWoke up on the wrong side of that one.§o Shook it off.
